title.value: “Your child needs surgery”: A survey-based evaluation of simulated expert consent conversations by key stakeholders
title.justification: The paper focuses on evaluating expert consent conversations for pediatric surgery from key stakeholders' perspectives, emphasizing the title's accuracy in encapsulating the study's primary theme.
title.quote: “Your child needs surgery”: A survey-based evaluation of simulated expert consent conversations by key stakeholders

extractions.description: This paper explores the quality of expert consent conversations in pediatric surgery by examining perspectives from key stakeholders, including families and healthcare professionals. It identifies strengths and gaps in the current process and suggests improvements to enhance patient engagement, trust, and satisfaction.

primary_category.justification: The paper is focused on the medical field, specifically pediatric surgery, and explores the informed consent process. As such, it doesn't align with the eco-responsible AI categories provided, which are primarily related to environmental and sustainable practices.
primary_category.quote: Informed consent is a critical component of medical and surgical care. In pediatric surgery, consent conversations are essential elements of pre-operative care which, when inadequate, may lead to significant adverse consequences...

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories provided are focused on environmental sustainability, climate change, and related areas, which do not match the focus of this medical-related research paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: Ultimately, the current process can be optimized and standardized through guidelines for best practices in pediatric surgical informed consent...

new_primary_category.justification: The paper addresses the ethics and communication involved in the process of obtaining informed consent in the medical field, which aligns with none of the pre-defined categories focused on environmental and sustainability issues.
new_primary_category.quote: The current literature on pediatric informed consent does not provide clear recommendations for effective and appropriate consent conversations...

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically focuses on the informed consent process in pediatric surgery and proposes improvements for patient engagement and trust, situating it in the broader context of healthcare communication.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Identified areas for improvement in the informed consent process based on multi-stakeholder input will guide the planned development of a consenting educational video resource.
